title: SolBehave: Evaluating the Behavioural Correctness of LLM-Generated Smart Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2610.18745v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models increasingly generate Solidity smart contracts that, once deployed, can never be patched, making a single latent fault permanent and exploitable. Yet current evaluations mostly ask only whether generated code compiles. We introduce SolBehave, a benchmark for evaluating the correctness of model-generated contracts at scale, moving beyond ad hoc unit tests. Across 250 real, reproducible Ethereum contracts, we apply three complementary tests of behavioural fidelity: differential fuzzing, historical-transaction replay, and, as our core contribution, synthetic-transaction replay guided by a Dynamic Condition Response (DCR) graph that enumerates the space of legitimate function-call sequences. translated_title: SolBehave：评估LLM生成智能合约的行为正确性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地生成Solidity智能合约，而这些合约一旦部署便无法修补，使得单个潜在缺陷成为永久性的且可被利用。然而，当前的评估大多只关注生成的代码能否通过编译。我们提出了SolBehave，这是一个用于大规模评估模型生成合约正确性的基准，超越了临时性的单元测试。在250个真实、可复现的以太坊合约上，我们应用了三种互补的行为保真度测试：差分模糊测试、历史交易重放，以及作为我们核心贡献的、由动态条件响应（DCR）图引导的合成交易重放，该图枚举了合法函数调用序列的空间。差分模糊测试在自动生成的输入上将每个生成的函数与原始函数进行比较；历史重放在链上实际接收到的交易上对整个合约进行比较；DCR引导的重放比较……
tldr: 本文提出SolBehave基准，通过差分模糊测试、历史交易重放以及基于DCR图的合成交易重放这三种互补方法，大规模评估LLM生成的Solidity智能合约的行为正确性，超越了仅检查代码能否编译的传统评估方式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SolBehave, a benchmark that evaluates the behavioral correctness of LLM-generated Solidity smart contracts at scale through differential fuzzing, historical-transaction replay, and DCR-graph-guided synthetic-transaction replay, moving beyond mere compilation checks.
